# The framework examples' cases, which scripts/go-examples.sh runs
# (docs/decisions/0014-PLAN-api-policy-gates.md Step 5, deviation D6):
#
#   <framework> <args…> => <exit> stdout|stderr <substring>
#
# The framework is the program's directory. The substring is the rest of the
# line, matched literally in the stream named. A bad flag's exit status is
# each framework's own, as measured: 2 for flag, 80 for kong, 1 for cobra and
# urfave. Every example passes a command's error through launch.ExitCode,
# so it exits with the error's own status
# (docs/decisions/0014-MADR-native-integration-api.md A1): 3 for a refusal,
# 2 for an unknown command or bad arguments.

flag save notes => 3 stderr refused: session.save
flag save --yes notes => 0 stdout saved notes
flag save --bogus notes => 2 stderr flag provided but not defined: -bogus

cobra save notes => 3 stderr refused: session.save
cobra save --yes notes => 0 stdout saved notes
cobra save --bogus notes => 1 stderr unknown flag: --bogus

kong save notes => 3 stderr refused: session.save
kong save --yes notes => 0 stdout saved notes
kong save --bogus notes => 80 stderr unknown flag --bogus

urfave save notes => 3 stderr refused: session.save
urfave save --yes notes => 0 stdout saved notes
urfave save --bogus notes => 1 stderr flag provided but not defined: -bogus

# run: any command by its ID, its arguments parsed by command.ParseArgs, the
# result written by command.WriteResult (docs/decisions/0014-PLAN-component-native-forms.md
# Step 11).
flag run --yes session.save notes => 0 stdout saved notes
flag run --yes --format=json session.save --name=notes => 0 stdout "notes"
flag run session.save notes => 3 stderr refused: session.save
flag run --yes session.save => 2 stderr /name: is required
flag run --yes session.save --bogus => 2 stderr --bogus is not a known flag
flag run no.such => 2 stderr unknown command
cobra run --yes session.save notes => 0 stdout saved notes
cobra run --yes --format=json session.save notes => 0 stdout "notes"
cobra run session.save notes => 3 stderr refused: session.save
cobra run --yes session.save --bogus => 2 stderr --bogus is not a known flag
kong run --yes session.save notes => 0 stdout saved notes
kong run --yes --format=json session.save --name=notes => 0 stdout "notes"
kong run session.save notes => 3 stderr refused: session.save
kong run --yes no.such => 2 stderr unknown command
urfave run --yes session.save notes => 0 stdout saved notes
urfave run --yes --format=json session.save --name=notes => 0 stdout "notes"
urfave run session.save notes => 3 stderr refused: session.save
urfave run --yes session.save --bogus => 2 stderr --bogus is not a known flag

# Completion through cobra's ValidArgsFunction and Registry.Complete: the
# IDs offered on the CLI, then a command's flags.
cobra __complete run se => 0 stdout session.save
cobra __complete run session.save -- => 0 stdout --name

# The --tui path, with no terminal: a warning naming the reason, then the
# line mode. --mode=plain goes to the line mode with no warning.
flag --tui => 0 stderr launch.input-not-terminal
flag --tui => 0 stdout line mode
flag --mode=plain => 0 stdout line mode
cobra --tui => 0 stderr launch.input-not-terminal
cobra --tui => 0 stdout line mode
cobra --mode=plain => 0 stdout line mode
kong --tui => 0 stderr launch.input-not-terminal
kong --tui => 0 stdout line mode
kong --mode=plain => 0 stdout line mode
kong --no-tui => 80 stderr unknown flag --no-tui
kong --tui --tui=false => 0 stdout line mode
urfave --tui => 0 stderr launch.input-not-terminal
urfave --tui => 0 stdout line mode
urfave --mode=plain => 0 stdout line mode
